meta.name: ffmpeg-encoder-check
meta.description: Check FFmpeg encoder availability before video encoding to avoid library mismatches

copy.tagline: 检查FFmpeg编码器可用性，避免编码失败
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用FFmpeg编码视频，需要提前确认编码器支持
copy.tagline_en: Check FFmpeg encoder availability to avoid encoding failures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently encode videos with FFmpeg and need to verify encoder support beforehand

howto.what: 当你要进行视频编码时，Claude会先运行命令检查你的FFmpeg安装中有哪些H.264编码器可用，然后根据结果推荐最合适的编码方式，避免因编码器缺失或版本不匹配导致失败。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude生成视频编码命令或脚本时，它会自动在开始前检查可用编码器。

say.text: 检查我电脑上的h264编码器有哪些
say.note: Claude会运行命令并解释结果。

say.text: 帮我写一个用libx264编码视频的命令

howto.what_en: When you want to encode video, Claude will first run a command to check which H.264 encoders are available in your FFmpeg installation, then recommend the best encoding strategy based on the results to avoid failures due to missing or mismatched libraries.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to generate video encoding commands or scripts, it will automatically perform an encoder availability check before proceeding.

say_en.text: Check which H.264 encoders are available on my system
say_en.note: Claude runs the command and explains the output.

say_en.text: Write a command to encode video using libx264
say_en.note: Claude first verifies libx264 is available.
